_: The hash of the pre-registration, written in the same commit as the document itself. The gate compares this to the file on disk: an edited pre-registration is a pre-registration that was not one, and the whole value of the exercise is that the levers were fixed before any score existed.
note: Nothing may be scored against a lever this document does not name, and nothing may be promoted out of the order it fixes. A correction is a NEW dated pre-registration that supersedes this one and says so.

superseded.why: Superseded 18-09-2026 by a second dated pre-registration, through the route this record's own note prescribes. The first edition is NOT edited, NOT withdrawn and its seal is kept here so an edit to it would still leave a trace — a superseded document whose hash stops being recorded is a document nobody can check any more.
